description:
prv Agni Extension Pack

An add-on for prv Agni that makes its spawning (intensity, closeness to population, ...) configurable, fixes its spawning for users of Wide Horizons, adds a new pseudo-quest to fight the Agni Progenitor, fix a planned but not working industry meant for Agni in the original mod and add a second one (both linked to said quest for acquisition). Also, console commands, the most interesting one allowing you to spawn them in your ongoing sector during an existing save (so you don't need to restart to find them). It does not modify or fork prv Agni or Wide Horizons or ship any of their code or art - it only adds.

> Download here <

Current version: 1.0.1 for Starsector 0.98a-RC8 and prv Agni v1.0.0 (probably works on later version of either, no reason it wouldn't)

Dependencies:

prv Agni (it requires prv Library itself)

Optional dependencies:

Wide Horizons: if detected, it will fix the prv Agni populating logic for it; tested on 1.4.0 and it should work fine on later versions without issues (I don't change the way WH works in any way, I only inject my new "pass" into its generator)
LunaLib: settings, sane defaults used if not present
Console Commands: add the agni* commands, great if you want to seed in an already on going game

Save-compatible:

safe to add to an existing save
safe to run agniseed in an angoing game (to populate the sector in agni)
removing the mod after saving will break your save

What it does

Fix the Agni generation/spawning rate in Wide Horizon rebalanced sector.
LunaLib settings allowing you to change the spawing generator for the Agni (want more or less of them ?); works for the Wide Horizon spawning but also for the vanilla spawning if you play without WH.
Add several agni* console commands, agniseed allow you to seed them through the sector (useful to fix a ongoing WH save started before you installed this), agnicount allows you to see how many of them there are (this check that the seedind worked)
Adds a "super agni mama" called the progenitor, in her dedicated "brood heart" system, and an intel chain to slowly figure out where they are the more you learn about (slaughter) the Agni.
Adds two industries unlocked by beating the progenitor, first the Xenobiological Outpost which is a prv Agni feature that is cut/not working but restored here and allows you to pacify Agni in the system and make them product organics for you (but you have to feed them or they turn feral !), second the Tamed Agni Hive a brand new industry that allows you to get agni defense patrol for yoru world and generate volatiles for you. You can disable either or both in the LunaLib settings.

Version history

1.0.1 (2026-07-06): first actual release: wide horizon compatibility, console commands, brood heart / progenitor quest line, restore xenobiological outpost industry, add the tamed hive.
